{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for '999999.99' in revenue
print("Rows with revenue == '999999.99':")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Confirm there are 6 such rows
print(f"Number of rows with '999999.99': {len(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])}")

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
print(f"Rows with commas in revenue: {df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum()}")

# Look at the 6 rows with '999999.99'
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("\nSample of QA rows:")
print(qa_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue']])

# Remove them
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Now check if any revenue values still have commas
print(f"Any remaining commas in revenue? {df_clean['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()}")

# Now safely cast to float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].astype(float)

# Verify
print(f"\nFirst 5 revenue values after parsing:")
print(df_clean['revenue'].head(5))"}
